title: See the numbers and reason behind each reviewed decision
description:
As a learner, I want each review entry to explain the advice with its equity numbers, so that I understand why a decision was right or wrong, not just that it was.

Completes REQ-043.1. Entries are read from the decision entries stored in the hand record (E03-S10), which were computed at the decision point with the decision-time observed-stats snapshot, not recomputed after the hand. Each entry shows street, board at that point, the user's action, the recommended action, the grade, equity % and required equity % (one decimal), the plain-English explanation (E07-S12) and the basis per opponent ('typical player' or 'based on N hands of this opponent'). The hint card (E08) and the review entry for the same decision must show the same recommendation and numbers (REQ-036.2). Reading or grading must not block the main thread (E03-S12). Preflop entries show the chart basis instead of equity numbers (REQ-043.9).

## Requirements covered
- REQ-035 (Must): Opponent range model — The advice engine shall estimate each opponent's range from that opponent's actions in the hand, starting from documented default ranges per action and adjusting toward the opponent's observed session statistics once 30 or more hands of that opponent have been observed.
- REQ-036 (Must): Deterministic advice — Given the same player view and the same observed opponent statistics, the advice engine shall always return the same recommendation, numbers, explanation and grade.
- REQ-043 (Must): Hand Review panel — When a hand ends in which the user made any decision other than folding preflop, the Table screen shall open the Hand Review panel beside the table, unless auto-open is turned off in Settings.

Covers: REQ-035, REQ-036, REQ-043

## Notes
With E08-S02 (stored record equals the hint card) this completes the hint-versus-review equality UI test asked for by E07-S13.

Plan key: E09-S02 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a scripted hand in which the user made 4 decisions, When the panel opens, Then each entry shows street, board at that point, the user's action, the recommended action, the grade and the explanation, and each flop, turn and river entry shows equity % and required equity %, each equal to the decision entry stored in the hand record [REQ-043.1]

Given a preflop decision holding A9o in the cutoff at 6-max, When the panel opens, Then its entry shows the chart basis "From the 6-max chart: raise A9o from the cutoff" and no equity % or required equity % [REQ-043.9]

Given a flop decision against an opponent observed for 40 hands, When the panel opens, Then the entry shows the basis "based on 40 hands of this opponent"; and a preflop entry shows "typical player" [REQ-035.4]

Given hint advice was requested through the advice worker at the user's flop decision and the opponent's observed hand count goes from 29 to 30 when the hand ends, When the panel opens, Then the flop entry's recommended action, equity %, required equity %, explanation and basis are identical to that hint result [REQ-036.2, REQ-043.1]

Given a 4-decision hand at a table of 10 players, When the panel opens at a 1280 x 720 window, Then all 4 entries with their explanations can be read in the panel without horizontal scrolling [REQ-043.1]

Given each user decision, When it is made, Then its review entry (grade, recommendation, equity, explanation, basis) is computed and stored at decision time off the main thread, replacing the hand-end recomputation in reviewEntries
Given a review entry is computed during play, When grading runs, Then it goes through the advice worker's grade request (src/ui/advice) and never runs on the main thread
Given a reviewed decision, When its numbers and reason are shown, Then the reason is the recommendation's explanation text (TASK-7.10) exactly as returned

Given a stored hand record with decisions (TASK-3.12), When the review panel shows that hand, Then each entry's recommendation, numbers, explanation and grade come from the stored decision (not recomputed), stored text is rendered as plain text (never HTML), and the storyboard SHOWDOWN fixture plays the user's moves through applyUserAction so its record parses
